rationale: PR #313 proved the canonical terminology resolver cannot identify multiple governed concept mentions inside one customer question. This extension scans only CanonicalConceptRegistry governed language keys with exact normalised word-boundary matching, skips ambiguous matches, and performs no fuzzy or semantic inference.
authority_impact: No new semantic authority is introduced. The existing governed CanonicalConceptRegistry remains the sole source of aliases and concept identity; this change only detects multiple exact mentions in one text.
